data.label: Only an application under review can be rejected by its shelter owner
Rejecting an application that does not exist

scenario.given: no application exists with the given id
scenario.when: the shelter owner attempts to reject it
scenario.then: a Not Found result is returned and no integration event is produced

scenario.given: an application submitted for a dog listing is under review
scenario.when: the shelter owner rejects it with a reason
scenario.then: the application status becomes Rejected and an ApplicationRejected event is produced carrying the dog's name and the rejection reason

data.label: What happens if the shelter owner tries to reject an already-rejected application?
